methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: in enhancing fault detection capabilities in AIoT-based environments, while also customizing ISO 50001:2018 standards to align with the unique energy management needs of academic institutions

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EnPI/EnB referenced only incidentally as generic ISO 50001:2018 requirements; the study's actual models (MobileNetV2/InceptionV3) are image classifiers for solar-panel defect/fault detection, and the ISO 50001 contribution is a qualitative organisational framework for universities. No EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study leverages open-source AI architectures, specifically MobileNetV2 and InceptionV3, as core components of the proposed fault detection system

stage1.notes: Dual-nature: (1) deep-learning fault-detection tool (MobileNetV2 80% / InceptionV3 90% accuracy on solar-panel defect image classification) plus (2) qualitative ISO 50001:2018 organisational customisation for universities, illustrated with Kangwon National University Samcheok Campus, South Korea (academic/buildings, not continuous-process). EnPI/EnB mentioned only incidentally; no energy-performance model characterised.
